title: Grateful Dead Live at KQED Studios on 1970-08-30

ai_review.summary: A low‑quality recording of a sluggish show – early footage is unwatchable and the performance lacks any standout moments.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers agree that this version suffers from poor audio/video fidelity and a lackluster, slow performance. One points listeners to an alternate IA upload, another calls it inferior to any real 1970 concert or album, and a third warns that the opening "Easy Wind" segment is essentially unwatchable while praising only the later Candyman footage.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently negative feedback on both musical performance and technical quality across three reviews, with no redeeming comments beyond a single song fragment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the recording as slow, unlistenable, and suffering from bad calibration/psychedelic visual effects; they recommend a different IA version instead.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is characterized as sluggish and sub‑par, with the opening track deemed unwatchable and overall performance not matching typical 1970 shows.
